title: Purchases
no_company_hint: Stock goes up and nobody is owed — for something bought with cash from nobody in particular.
add_material_hint: Record stock coming in — the material, how much you added, and what it cost.
duplicate_item: {{item}} is on two lines — keep both if the price differs.
price_missing: No bought price for {{item}} — type one for this purchase.
void_explanation: Stock for {{count}} materials will be taken back out, {{amount}} comes off what we owe, and anything paid with it is taken back too. Payments made to it later stay on the account.
edit_window_closed: This purchase can no longer be edited — void it and enter it again.
no_payments: Nothing paid against this purchase yet
settle_in_full_hint: Closes this purchase exactly, even when the last payment is in the other currency
accounts_hint: What we sold, what it cost us, what we bought and spent — for the period you choose
net_hint: Profit, less expenses and broken goods not paid back
uncosted_warning: Lines sold with no bought price: {{count}} — they are left out of the cost and the profit
empty_bought: Nothing was bought in this period
empty_materials: No material moved in this period
void_expense_hint: It stays in History with your reason, and leaves the totals.
new_purchase_hint: Who you bought from, what came in, what each one cost, and what you paid them now.
notes_hint: Optional — their invoice number, the driver, anything worth keeping
add_first_line: Add the first material you bought.
choose_company_first: Choose who you bought from to save
paid_now_none_hint: The whole purchase goes on what we owe them, until you pay it from the company's page.
paid_now_hint: Saved as a payment to them on the same day, with its own receipt; anything left stays owed.
